mothling.name: Mothling
mothling.setup_hint: Try a quiet forest setup with a little light after dark.
clues: Strange red lights between the trees.
Wing-shaped shadows cross the clearing.
Artificial lights seem to fascinate it.

bigfoot.name: Sprigfoot
bigfoot.setup_hint: Natural cover, berries, and quiet woods make promising signs.
clues: Large footprints.
Missing berries.
Wood knocking deeper in the trees.

nightcrawler.name: Stilts
nightcrawler.setup_hint: Keep an open, quiet patch where something tall could wander through.
clues: Tall pale shapes cross open ground.
Sightings cluster around strangely ordinary human objects.

froglet.name: Froglet
froglet.setup_hint: Water and damp plant life make the clearing feel inviting.
clues: Small wet footprints stop abruptly.
A strange croak answers from the creek.
Something watches from beside the water.

squonk.name: Squonk
squonk.setup_hint: A damp, sheltered, quiet forest setup may draw out a sensitive visitor.
clues: Tiny puddles appear with no rain.
Soft crying comes from the brush.
Wet tracks circle the clearing.

dover_demon.name: Dovi
dover_demon.setup_hint: Quiet rocks and cover after dark give a shy watcher somewhere to perch.
clues: Long fingers briefly curl around a stone wall.
Two enormous eyes reflect the moonlight.
Something small moves between the rocks.

chupacabra.name: Chup Chup
chupacabra.setup_hint: Warm nights and scattered human trinkets may interest a mischievous visitor.
clues: Small clawed tracks circle the campsite.
A shiny object has been moved.
A spined silhouette darts behind a rock.

hodag.name: Hoddy
hodag.setup_hint: Forest cover, warm rocks, and an interesting snack suit a stubborn little visitor.
clues: Scratches appear on a warm boulder.
Something heavy rustles through the brush.
A snack disappears beside the rocks.

thunderbird.name: Rumble
thunderbird.setup_hint: Watch high, open places when violent weather rolls in.
clues: A shadow crosses the entire clearing.
Thunder answers from a cloudless direction.
An enormous feather is caught high in a tree.
